page.layout: One scanned image showing no printed text: a grey, speckled surface on the left and a dark brown band on the right, apparently the cover or board of a book. No printed page is visible.
page.notes: The scan shows only a mottled grey surface and a dark brown strip at the right edge, with no letters, numbers, headings or running text. Nothing printed could be transcribed. This appears to be a digitiser's cover image or a photograph of the binding rather than a page of the book.
